{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_ages = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age
total_customers = len(valid_ages)
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Number of valid age entries: {total_customers}")
print(f"Mean age: {mean_age}")"}
